entry.title: CHOPARD L.U.C - The Art of the Gesture

media:group.media:title: CHOPARD L.U.C - The Art of the Gesture
media:group.media:description:
What does it take to move people? In a conversation between Friend of the Maison Gautier Capucon and Chopard Chief of Staff Karl-Fritz Scheufele, music and watchmaking reveal striking parallels. From mastering the right sound to perfecting a complication, both disciplines demand patience, precision and countless repetitions before emotion can flow effortlessly. Discover how both are true Artisans of Emotions, transforming technical mastery into lasting emotion.

media:group.media:title: Chopard Alpine Eagle Rhone Blue
media:group.media:description:
Inspired by the blue tones of the Rhone River as it flows from the Swiss Alps to the Mediterranean Sea, the Alpine Eagle Rhone Blue in Lucent Steel™ captures nature's journey in a radiant dial inspired by the eagle's iris. A tribute to the majestic bird that inspired the collection and to the mission of the Alpine Eagle Foundation, it offers a fresh perspective on summer time.
